protocol: Blind review (Claude vision) of val2 renders, written after the last algorithm change; same rubric as results/visual/judgments.json; keys unopened while judging.

w-gov.note: A keeps the 法定/承诺 sub-headers on one line and the 3-column group header on 2 lines; B and C stack 法/定 and 承/诺 one character per line and are taller.

w-sla.note: B/C identical and compact. A gives Support channels less room (3-line row). D splits 'Profession|al' mid-word.

w-ja-rowspan.note: A/B near-identical. C narrows the 日程 rowgroup header (1/日/目) and the 講師 column (情報/シス/テム/部) and is tallest.

w-ids.note: A keeps prose readable and only splits the 32-hex trace id (unavoidable at this width). B/D are similar with slightly narrower Summary. C keeps the long trace id whole and starves Summary to 1–2 words per line.

w-ar-multi.note: All three layouts are visually identical; no preference.

w-tall-rowheader.note: C keeps every value whole (2.4 亿, ≤ 12%) by letting the long row headers wrap into 3–4 lines. A/B split '≤|12%' and '2.4|亿'. D also splits 2.61|亿 and wraps the 实际值 header.

w-th-colspan.note: A keeps ห้องดีลักซ์ whole (wraps at the word boundary before วิวทะเล) and only wraps the วันหยุด sub-header at a word boundary. B/C split ห้องดีลัก|ซ์ inside the word.

w-mixed-2d.note: A/B near-identical, all dates whole. C splits every date 05-|06 to widen the merged note.
